body.name: First-order exact-mixture oracle gain
body.construction:
\[
\mathcal B_\infty(\beta)
=\lim_{n\to\infty}\mathcal B_{T_n^{\mathrm{full}}}(\beta),
\qquad
M_\beta
=\mathcal B_\infty(\beta)^{\mathsf T}W\mathcal B_\infty(\beta),
\qquad
g_\beta(z)=z^{\mathsf T}G_\infty(\beta)z,
\]
and
\[
a(\beta)
=(1-\eta)\operatorname{tr}(M_\beta)
\left[
E\{g_\beta(Z)\}
-\alpha^{-1}E\!\left\{
g_\beta(Z)\mathbf 1(g_\beta(Z)\leq q_{\alpha,\beta})
\right\}
\right].
\]
